title: In This Town, Every Kid Has a Monster in Their Closet
description: Every kid in my town has a monster in the closet. You have to feed it. Last night mine stopped eating…

scenes.narration: In this town, every kid has a monster living in their closet. And it's *your* job to feed it.
Three cookies every night. Never more, never less. Mom says the monsters keep the *other* things away.
My best friend Leo forgot once. His closet was empty the next morning. And Leo didn't talk for a week.
So I never forgot. Three cookies. Every night. For nine years.
Until last night. I put the cookies in front of the closet... and they were still there in the morning.
I tried chocolate cookies. Nothing. I tried pizza. Nothing. I even tried my brother's birthday cake.
I sat in front of that closet for hours, begging it to eat something. Anything at all.
At midnight, I heard footsteps. Not from the closet. From the *hallway*.
My door creaked open. And in the hallway stood something tall, with glowing *purple* eyes.
Then my closet door slammed open. Two yellow eyes. My monster. Wide awake.
It hadn't stopped eating because it was sick. It stopped because it was *saving its strength*.
All night, I heard them fighting in the dark. I didn't move. I didn't breathe.
At five fifty nine, everything went quiet. Then something knocked on my bedroom door. Three times.
Something crashed into the wall. Then a growl. Then a scream that didn't sound human.
I don't know which one is standing out there. Should I open the door, or trust my monster and stay in bed?
